import json,hashlib,struct
from pathlib import Path
HOST='22b3aa05b32d490547aafc7da84a3c00fa29e575a1fc6f8ba07c0fdf5087dbd2'
CUBIN='4e589b75e04e4caed9044ace3f42a12532c7f4694456095d15ee9339c5b7f115'
PREFIX='Program hit CUDA_ERROR_NOT_FOUND (error 500) due to "named symbol not found" on CUDA API call to cuModuleGetGlobal_v2.'
def binary_proof(data):
 assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==HOST
 phoff=struct.unpack_from('<Q',data,32)[0];size,count=struct.unpack_from('<HH',data,54)
 def read(va,n):
  for i in range(count):
   typ,flags,off,vaddr,paddr,filesz,memsz,align=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',data,phoff+i*size)
   if typ==1 and vaddr<=va and va+n<=vaddr+filesz:return data[off+va-vaddr:off+va-vaddr+n]
  raise AssertionError('unmapped ELF address')
 for call,lea,literal,name in [(0x16aa07,0x16a9ea,0x286c73,b'plow_packet_hash_lo'),(0x16aa4f,0x16aa32,0x286c86,b'plow_packet_hash_hi')]:
  raw=read(call,5);assert raw[0]==0xe8 and call+5+struct.unpack('<i',raw[1:])[0]==0x16bc40
  raw=read(lea,7);assert raw[:3]==b'\x48\x8d\x0d' and lea+7+struct.unpack('<i',raw[3:])[0]==literal
  assert read(literal,19)==name
 assert read(0x16a9fe,6)==bytes.fromhex('41b813000000') and read(0x16aa46,6)==bytes.fromhex('41b813000000')
 assert read(0x16be6a,3)==bytes.fromhex('ff5078')
 for call,target in [(0x1458a7,0x169e50),(0x7e909,0x141be0),(0x7542a,0x141be0),(0x805c0,0x73210),(0x94b46,0x81ce0)]:
  raw=read(call,5);assert raw[0]==0xe8 and call+5+struct.unpack('<i',raw[1:])[0]==target
 assert read(0x81ce1,2)==bytes.fromhex('ffd7')
 return True

def classify(text,report,host,cubin):
 batch=report["batch"];assert batch in [8,16]
 assert host==HOST and cubin==CUBIN
 expected=['COMPUTE-SANITIZER']
 for i,pc in enumerate(['16aa0b','16aa53','16aa0b','16aa53']):
  offsets=['16be6c',pc,'1458ab']+(['7e90d'] if i<2 else ['7542e','805c4'])+['81ce2','94b4a']
  expected += [PREFIX,'Saved host backtrace up to driver entry point at error']
  expected += [f'Host Frame:  [0x{x}] in decode_dump' for x in offsets]
  expected += ['Host Frame: __libc_start_call_main [0x2b284] in libc.so.6','Host Frame: __libc_start_main [0x2b337] in libc.so.6','Host Frame:  [0x5b1f4] in decode_dump']
 expected += ['ERROR SUMMARY: 4 errors']
 actual=[line[9:].strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith('=========') and line[9:].strip()]
 assert actual==expected,'unexpected sanitizer diagnostic or frame chain'
 assert report['complete'] is True and report['passed'] is True and report['exact_inactive_reset_checks']==2*batch*(batch-1)+2*(3*batch-3)
 assert report['reset_zero_checks']==2*batch
 allslots=list(range(batch));schedule=[allslots,allslots[::2],allslots[1::2],allslots,[batch-1],allslots,[0,batch-1],allslots]
 names=['act.x','act.gdn.conv','act.gdn.core','state.qwen.0.conv','state.qwen.0.gdn']
 expected_rows={(s,t,n) for t,slots in enumerate(schedule) for s in slots for n in names}
 assert len(report['rows'])==5*(5*batch+3) and {(x['slot'],x['tick'],x['tensor']) for x in report['rows']}==expected_rows
 assert all(x['passed'] is True and 0<=x['relative_l2']<=.003 for x in report['rows'])
 assert all(x['bitexact'] is True and x['relative_l2']==0 and x['max_abs']==0 for x in report['rows'] if x['tensor']!='act.x')
 return {'classified':True,'raw_exit_code':99,'exact_optional_api_probes':4,'device_access_reports':0,'zero_error_memcheck':False,'batch':batch,'upstream_state_rows_bitexact':4*(5*batch+3),'bounded_output_rows':5*batch+3,'inactive_reset_checks':2*batch*(batch-1)+2*(3*batch-3),'reset_zero_checks':2*batch,'qualification':'fresh unfiltered wide-host run; exact binary/calls/rodata/full-frame-chain classifier'}

def main():
 import sys
 m=Path(__file__).parent;p=m.parent;b=int(sys.argv[1]);run=m/f'b{b}'
 manifest=json.loads((m/'manifest.json').read_text())
 for path,digest in manifest['hashes'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,path
 assert binary_proof((p/'bin/decode_dump').read_bytes())
 assert json.loads((run/'raw-status.json').read_text())['returncode']==99

 text=(run/'raw.log').read_text()
 assert text.count(f'PLOW_NV_CUBIN={p}/splitk.cubin')==1 and text.count(f'PLOW_NV_CUBIN={p}/default.cubin')==1
 out=classify(text,report,HOST,CUBIN)
 quality=json.loads((run/'numerical-validation.json').read_text());assert quality['accepted'] and quality['batch']==b and len(quality['scratch'])==8 and len(quality['repeat_rows'])==2*(5*b+3)
 out.update(host_sha256=HOST,cubin_sha256=CUBIN,reference_cubin_sha256=manifest['hashes'][str(p/'default.cubin')],raw_log_sha256=hashlib.sha256((run/'raw.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),numerical_validation_sha256=hashlib.sha256((run/'numerical-validation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256((m/'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
 (run/'classification.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
